summary: 依据父级在 G86/parent-return-consolidated.json 中归并的全部 16 项实质修改要求，全面核准原始 PDF/XML，完成逐项定点修改。彻底剔除全部未经证实之数值（含 31(7) W.u.、98Zr 0_2 4.2 ns、Ge76 伪角度误差 13(4) 度等），校准 98Mo 真实能级半衰期与运动学禁戒，升级 Karmakar 2026 8页出版全论文，订正两态混合 tan 2theta 符号与 E0 质子数 Z^2 因子及基底正交条件，核验 29 项保留数据全部通过存在性、页码有效性、零控制字符与短锚点逐字比对自查。不执行本地引擎编译，统一由 G76 集中处理。

items_fixed.short_source_anchor: the laboratory frame is spherical for non-zero spin states or zero spin states
items_fixed.actual_change: Clarified that projection constructs good-I trial states from a single intrinsic reference, not that physical finite nuclear states are exact single projections; stated lab stationary states expand in {|I^pi M>} basis, accounted for experimental ensembles and P, T conservation under strong/EM interactions.

items_fixed.source_locator: sec-2-6.tex Section 2.6.3 (ref:sec-2-6-3), Bohr & Mottelson Vol. II PDF 80
items_fixed.short_source_anchor: term represents a collective effect of the rotational motion
items_fixed.actual_change: Deleted duplicate standalone Inglis-Belyaev formula and false universal 1/3-1/2 or << bound; cross-referenced Section 2.6.3 and emphasized mass-dependent Fermi level density g(e_F) and pairing gap Delta.

items_fixed.short_source_anchor: It is possible to evaluate expectation values of the E2 invariants in the laboratory frame
items_fixed.actual_change: Connected to 2.1 and 2.4; stated low-order invariants do not uniquely fix continuous gamma distribution and experimental truncations prevent direct angle variance measurement; deleted arbitrary degree threshold.

items_fixed.short_source_anchor: In this section we address the very important issue of simplifying the calculation of matrix elements
items_fixed.actual_change: Stated differential cross section dsigma/dOmega is direct observable while S_j depends on optical potentials and reaction models (DWBA/adiabatic); removed 'unique channel' claim for fusion, noted Coulex reaches I=20-30 in deformed rotors; expanded lifetime techniques beyond DSAM/RDDS.
Corrected sign of tan(2theta_0) to negative: tan(2theta_0) = -2V / (E_B - E_A); explicitly declared E_A <= E_B and branch theta_0 in (-pi/4, 0] for V > 0.
Included explicit Z^2 factor for mean-square charge radius per proton; declared orthogonality of unmixed basis and vanishing of intrinsic off-diagonal E0 transition in this basis.

Replaced erroneous 2.4(7) ps with exact Table I values: tau(2+_1)=3.3(5) ps, B(E2 downward)=410(60) e2 fm4, tau(2+_2)=8(+4/-2) ps, B(E2 2_2->2_1)=620(210) e2 fm4, B(E2 2_2->0_1)=1.5(5) e2 fm4; reiterated Q(2+_1) is purely theoretical.

items_fixed.source_locator: Clement 2007 (PRC 75, 054313) PDF 11 Table VI, PDF 15 Table XI
items_fixed.short_source_anchor: PDF 11 Table VI: Q_s=-0.7(2) eb; PDF 15 Table XI: Q_s=-0.53(+0.24/-0.23) eb
items_fixed.actual_change: Replaced false +0.59 / -0.57 numbers with exact Table VI and Table XI values: 76Kr Q_s(2+_1) = -0.7(2) eb, 74Kr Q_s(2+_1) = -0.53(+0.24/-0.23) eb (both centroids negative); stated 0+ state has 0 static moment; explained shape coexistence based on global two-band mixing fit.

items_fixed.short_source_anchor: Evidence for rigid triaxial deformation in 76Ge from a model-independent analysis
items_fixed.actual_change: Removed invented sigma(delta)=13(4) deg angle variance; reported effective triaxial angle delta ~ 25-27 deg and invariant dispersions sigma_<Q^2>, sigma_<cos3delta>; stated rigid triaxiality as author's model-bounded interpretation.

Reported exact Table 1 values: 68Ni 0+_3 T_1/2 = 0.57(5) ns, decays >98.1% via E2 to 2+_1 (39.0(34) e2 fm4), with E0 to 0+_1 (<0.0173, rho^2(E0)x10^3 < 1.0) and 0+_2 (<0.0018, <0.28); 70Ni candidate (0+_2) T_1/2 = 1.65(+0.30/-0.25) ns; removed false claims of nanosecond lifetimes + strong E0.

Accurately defined S(I) as odd-odd rotational band energy spacing per spin; distinguished it from even-even gamma-band second-difference staggering; stated Ding 2025 is idealized PRM theoretical study with CDFT inputs, without real Cobalt experimental data.

items_fixed.source_locator: Chen & Singh 2020 (NDS 164, 1) PDF 2 Adopted Levels, Thomas 2016 NPA 947 XML Table 2
items_fixed.actual_change: Reported exact adopted values: 0+_2 E = 734.75(4) keV, T_1/2 = 21.8(9) ns (derived mean lifetime tau = 31.45(130) ns); 2+_1 E = 787.384(17) keV, T_1/2 = 3.47(7) ps (tau = 5.01(10) ps); noted 734.75 < 787.38 forbids downward 0_2->2_1 gamma emission; deleted unverified 31(7) W.u.

items_fixed.source_locator: Karmakar et al. 2026 (NPA 1066, 123265) PDF 4 Table 1, PDF 6 Table 2
items_fixed.actual_change: Upgraded from DAE summary to full published paper Karmakar 2026 NPA 1066; reported Table 1 new lines 1833.3(5) keV and 1585.8(6) keV with (E3) as lowest allowed multipolarity and R_DCO blank; Table 2 B(E3)/B(E2) ratios 66.05(2701) and 153.81(3331) fm2 (~4x 100Ru, but no lifetime measured so no absolute E3 strength); relegated DAE 2025 to preliminary historical report.

items_fixed.short_source_anchor: 2.95 MeV with B; total observed strength of 1.7
items_fixed.actual_change: Replaced erroneous numbers with exact original paper values: 2.95 MeV B(E1)up = 0.016 e2 fm2, 4.5-5.5 MeV cluster (centered ~4.9 MeV) sum B(E1)up ~ 0.1 e2 fm2, total observed M1 = 1.7 mu_N^2 (local 2-4 MeV ~1.0 mu_N^2); 2.95 MeV interpreted as possible two-phonon and 5 MeV interpreted combining TAC-QRPA as low-lying octupole resonance LEOR, not direct E3 static measurement.

items_fixed.short_source_anchor: NRF on 0+ ground state dominated by dipole E1/M1 but E2 can excite 2+
items_fixed.actual_change: Clarified that while NRF on 0+ ground state is dominated by E1/M1 dipole transitions populating 1+- states, E2 absorption can also populate 2+ states; there is no theorem that NRF exclusively populates spin 1, but observed states are restricted to low multipolarity absorption.

items_fixed.short_source_anchor: LaTeX standard formatting without literal Markdown bolding
items_fixed.actual_change: Removed all literal Markdown ** bolding; replaced internal '严格科学合同' with '比较方法与物理判据'; maintained clean PDF page, table, and short anchor references for every numerical claim; no own latexmk execution.
